description: Where is a setting in an unknown admin panel: follows the panel's menu links (same origin) until a page contains the keyword and reports the menu path. Navigates the tab, leaves it on the page found, stops at max_pages.

keyword.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "webp", "cron", "maintenance mode"

tab_id.description: Target tab; omitted = last tab navigated in this session, else the active one

name: find_setting
